page_title: CAG 0-0 ROM | Cagliari v AS Roma 18/08/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' That's it for today, Federico La Penna has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+4' Stephan El Shaarawy (AS Roma) was close to scoring after he unleashed a powerful shot which went a whisker wide of the left post.
90+2' Paulo Daniel Dentello Azzi (Cagliari) gives the referee no choice but to show him a yellow card.
90+1' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Cagliari comes to nothing.

90+1' Gianluca Lapadula (Cagliari) plays a dangerous chip pass into the box in an attempt to set up one of his teammates, but the effort is intercepted by one of the defenders. Cagliari have been awarded a corner kick.
90+1' We will have 4 min. of added time.
90' Substitution. Matias Soule is replaced by Stephan El Shaarawy (AS Roma).
90' Daniele De Rossi has decided to make a change. Tammy Abraham (AS Roma) replaces Artem Dovbyk.
86' Gianluca Lapadula (Cagliari) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Roberto Piccoli.
84' Alessandro Deiola (Cagliari) violates the laws of the game and is shown a deserved yellow card by the referee.
83' A goal, which was scored by Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma), was disallowed due to offside.
82' Roberto Piccoli (Cagliari) stretches for the rebound inside the box, but can only send it high over the bar.
82' Razvan Marin (Cagliari) tries his luck with a shot from the edge of the box, but the ball crashes against the crossbar! It would have been a superb goal.
80' Artem Dovbyk (AS Roma) had a good opportunity when he latched on to a cross from the wing, but his header from the six-yard box wasn't accurate enough and the ball glanced away off the bar!
79' Roberto Piccoli (Cagliari) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
78' Gianluca Mancini (AS Roma) goes for goal but he directs his effort just wide of the left post.
76' The foul by Artem Dovbyk (AS Roma) was seen by Federico La Penna who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
75' Mile Svilar displays his ability to read the game and clears the danger after Leonardo Pavoletti (Cagliari) threatened to latch onto a through ball from just outside the box.
73' The defensive wall does its job and blocks the free kick from Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) on the edge of the box.
72' Substitution. Michel Adopo (Cagliari) has come on for Matteo Prati.
71' Davide Nicola decides to make a substitution. Zito Luvumbo will be replaced by Leonardo Pavoletti (Cagliari).
71' An attempted cross from Zeki Celik (AS Roma) is cleared.
69' The substitution is prepared. Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Nicola Zalewski.
67' The ball is out of play. Cagliari win a corner kick.
66' Roberto Piccoli (Cagliari) receives a sweet pass inside the box, but his effort on goal is blocked by the defender.
66' Zeki Celik (AS Roma) sends a cross into the box, but Simone Scuffet comes off his line to gather the ball.
65' Tommaso Baldanzi (AS Roma) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
65' Paulo Daniel Dentello Azzi (Cagliari) is unable to feed a through ball into the path of his teammates.
63' Bryan Cristante (AS Roma) creates himself some space in front of goal and connects with the resulting free kick. His header is slightly mistimed and sails inches wide of the right post.
61' We are about to witness a subsitution. Tommaso Baldanzi (AS Roma) for Enzo Le Fee.
59' A cross into the box picks out Razvan Marin (Cagliari), who steps inside his marker and fizzes a shot well wide of the right post.
58' Roberto Piccoli (Cagliari) unleashes a cannonball of a shot from the edge of the area, but it zips narrowly wide of the left post.
57' Matias Soule (AS Roma) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
56' Matias Soule (AS Roma) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender.

55' Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) receives a precise pass in the box and takes the shot early. The ball heads low towards the middle of the goal, but Simone Scuffet shows off his skills and makes a brilliant save to deny him.
54' Paulo Daniel Dentello Azzi (Cagliari) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
51' Tommaso Augello (Cagliari) floats the free kick into the box, but it's easily cleared by the first man.
51' Bryan Cristante (AS Roma) was too forceful with his tackle and Federico La Penna interrupted the game to signal a free kick. Cagliari have a free kick.
49' Nicola Zalewski (AS Roma) was close to scoring after he unleashed a powerful shot which went a whisker over the crossbar.
49' AS Roma take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

48' Matias Soule (AS Roma) finds himself in space on the edge of the box and smashes a glorious looking effort towards the right side of the goal, but Simone Scuffet thwarts him with a great two-handed save.
47' Zito Luvumbo (Cagliari) shows too much aggression while trying to break free from his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
46' The whistle blows and Federico La Penna starts the second half.
45+1' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
44' Cagliari have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
43' Zeki Celik (AS Roma) passes the ball into the box but an opposing player clears.
41' Nicola Zalewski (AS Roma) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
41' It's a nice effort by Razvan Marin (Cagliari) from the edge of the box, but it's low towards the middle of the goal and straight down the throat of Mile Svilar. Easy save.
38' The ball possession at the moment is 51:49.
36' Artem Dovbyk (AS Roma) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
34' Nicola Zalewski (AS Roma) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
31' Neat passing move from AS Roma in order to create new attacking opportunities.
29' Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
28' Artem Dovbyk (AS Roma) picks up a long through ball, but Simone Scuffet deserves praise for a brilliant reaction and interception.
27' Enzo Le Fee (AS Roma) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
24' The free kick from long range, taken by AS Roma, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
21' Cagliari exchange some quick one-two passes over a small area and control the game. Now they make a mistake and lose the ball and the whole situation changes in the blink of an eye.
20' Matias Soule (AS Roma) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
18' Razvan Marin (Cagliari) dinks a fine lofted pass from the free kick. However, one of the defenders heads the ball out of danger.
17' Federico La Penna couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) and blew his whistle. Cagliari are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
16' AS Roma seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
15' Artem Dovbyk (AS Roma) plays a through ball inside the box, but it's too strong and Simone Scuffet comes off his line to intercept.
13' Zito Luvumbo (Cagliari) finds space on the edge of the box, but his wild shot goes high over the bar.
12' The resulting set piece from Cagliari is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
11' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Cagliari, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
10' Zeki Celik (AS Roma) commits a rough challenge and Federico La Penna blows his whistle for a foul. Cagliari will take a free kick.
9' Gabriele Zappa (Cagliari) attempts to find one of his teammates, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone.
7' Enzo Le Fee (AS Roma) whips in a cross from the corner, but Simone Scuffet is well positioned and punches the ball away.
7' Nicola Zalewski (AS Roma) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. Corner kick. AS Roma will have an opportunity.
6' The free kick from long range, taken by AS Roma, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
6' One of the Cagliari players tripped an opponent and conceded a foul. AS Roma are awarded a free kick.
5' The corner is swung in and Mateusz Wieteska (Cagliari) leaps above the defence only to send his header a whisker over the bar from close in.
4' Razvan Marin (Cagliari) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.
3' Roberto Piccoli (Cagliari) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
AS Roma will kick-off.
Today's referee will be Federico La Penna.
